response.sql: WITH filtered_labs AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, GOT, GPT, APPT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), centromea_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) as avg_got_gpt, AVG(CASE WHEN APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APPT - PT END) as avg_appt_pt FROM filtered_labs GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN avg_got_gpt IS NOT NULL THEN avg_got_gpt END) as avg_got_minus_gpt, AVG(CASE WHEN avg_appt_pt IS NOT NULL THEN avg_appt_pt END) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM centromea_stats
